How many passengers are in the dataset?.answer: There are 891 passengers in the dataset.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_passengers FROM passengers;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM passengers WHERE Survived = 1
SELECT Survived, COUNT(*) FROM passengers GROUP BY Survived

What is the average age of all passenger.answer: The average age of all passengers (for whom age data is available) rounded to 1 decimal place is **29.7** years.
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Age), 1) AS avg_age FROM passengers;
SELECT AVG(Age), COUNT(Age), COUNT(*) FROM passengers;
